guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：大古力水電站
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant
guides.concept: 以多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作解析大古力水電站：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant through multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Coulee流量水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多電廠機組工況。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水路與spillway暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識forebay與壩體載荷。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識灌溉泵發協作。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大古力水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識生態與泥砂指標。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify coulee flow/head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multiple-powerhouse units in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify waterway/spillway transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify forebay/dam loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify irrigation pump/generation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify ecology/sediment metrics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交灌溉泵發協作的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交生態與泥砂指標的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交生態與泥砂指標的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for irrigation pump/generation.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for ecology/sediment metrics.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for ecology/sediment metrics.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

practice: 對照Coulee流量水頭與德基有效水頭，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare coulee flow/head with techi effective head and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Techi Hydropower System, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.
Start from ecology/sediment metrics and propose an observation distinguishing multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping from thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, including uncertainty.
